summary: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14/G16 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Thermal throttling, BSOD (Blue Screen of Death), or other system crashes due to overheating, driver issues, or BIOS/UEFI firmware problems.
suggested_solution: Check NVIDIA GeForce drivers (e.g., 530.x) and Intel UEFI firmware (e.g., version 2200 or later); ensure proper cooling and maintain a clean system.
